src/app/actions/import.ts: A failed immediate privacy discard is converted to persistence-safe user copy and a bounded parse-failure diagnostic.
A failed import-event insert cannot retain the paste and is returned as a sanitized staging failure.
A failed routine parsing-event insert discards the staged import instead of exposing the database error.
A failed deterministic exercise-library lookup discards staged import and parsing data instead of retaining partial review state.
A failed final review-stage write discards and redacts every staged routine artifact instead of returning a partial success.
src/services/activities.ts: Intl throws for an invalid timezone; the Zod refinement intentionally converts that into a validation failure.
src/services/coaching.ts: Malformed legacy coaching JSON is treated as an unreadable optional review instead of failing the surrounding History read.
src/services/export.ts: Malformed stored assistant JSON exports with empty structured answer columns while preserving the durable raw row fields.
src/services/live-coaching.ts: Malformed completed-answer JSON yields no structured answer while the durable message remains available for status display.
